fullContentHtml:
RSSB Female Supervisor Correction Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) has released the Correction Form Notice for the recruitment of Female Supervisor posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 72 posts. Applications for the RSSB Female Supervisor Recruitment 2026 were accepted from January 07, 2026, to February 11, 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 24 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their RSSB Female Supervisor Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 06 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 07 January 2026
  • Last Date : 11 February 2026 (Extend)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 11 February 2026
  • Correction Form : 31 July to 06 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 24 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 17 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, OBC (Creamy Layer) : Rs. 600/-
  • EWS , OBC (Non Creamy Layer), EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is RSSB Female Supervisor Correction Form 2026?

RSSB Female Supervisor Correction Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 11 February 2026 (Extend).

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://rssb.rajasthan.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
